text:
Angela: Great all-hands today. Two quick follow-ups for the runtime roadmap that PMs asked for: (1) kernel compatibility guarantees and how long we keep v3/v4 side-by-side, (2) customer-facing wording for rollouts and opt-out knobs, (3) whether SDKs need changes for streaming + kv-cache behavior.

Devon: Compatibility: we guarantee ABI compatibility for model weights and KV layout for 6 months after a major kernel change. During that window both v3 and v4 will be available in Hosted and Dedicated. After 6 months we'll mark older kernels deprecated with a 90-day deprecation notice.

Kai: SDK impact: streaming API remains the same, but kv-cache semantics tightened in v4 (better eviction, different seq-based keys). We'll release minor SDK updates to add an opt-in flag `kv_compat_mode: "v3"` so customers can pin behavior during migration. No major breaking changes expected.

Lina: For PMs / customer comms: suggested blurb -> "We will rollout kernel-v4 with a staged canary and maintain kernel-v3 for at least 6 months. Customers can pin older kernels or opt-in to v4 behavior via the Console or SDK flags. Automatic fallback will protect running sessions but may result in temporary latency differences." Feel free to reuse.

Jorge: Ops note: rolling both kernels side-by-side increases memory footprint on canary nodes. We'll create a dedicated canary pool with mixed images to avoid cross-contamination. Also scripting to toggle `kv_compat_mode` per-route.

infra-bot: [info] 2025-10-05T09:14 - Canary pool created: kernel-mixed-10. Policy: 24h observation before broader rollout.

Angela: PM question: will we publish a migration checklist? They want a one-liner for the roadmap and a link to a migration playbook.

Devon: Yes 97 migration checklist will include: how to pin kernels, how to set `kv_compat_mode`, recommended microbatch sizes for v4, and a small regression test to run (curl example included). We'll link it in the release notes.

Kai: I'll add the curl examples to the SDK repo README. e.g.:

`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"kernel-v4","kv_compat_mode":"v3","batch_size":16}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

Lina: One more ask from Legal: explicit line about data handling during migration (no longer than a sentence). Any wording suggestions?

Jorge: Suggestion: "During staged rollouts no customer data is moved between tenants; routing changes keep session affinity where possible and audit logs capture any fallback events."

Angela: Perfect. Action items: Devon publish kernel lifecycle doc + 6-month guarantee; Kai push SDK minor with `kv_compat_mode` flag; Lina draft customer-facing blurb and migration checklist; Jorge provision canary pool and toggle scripts. Ping back with links. :white_check_mark:

Devon: Will post docs by EOD PST.

Kai: SDK PR incoming, ETA 48h.

Lina: Draft ready in ~3 hours.

Jorge: Canary pool metrics dashboard link will follow once provisioned.
